fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole pontoon (tritoon) boat on a trailer.
findings: Light dulling and faint water marks on the aluminum pontoon tubes, most visible on the port and center tubes in the first photo
Light soiling in the seams and piping of the cream vinyl lounge seating
Cream helm seat vinyl shows light creasing and dullness that a vinyl clean and conditioner would brighten
Light dust on the teak-look floor and the helm console
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the South Bay tritoon and it looks well kept. The pontoon tubes have some light dullness, and the cream vinyl seating could brighten up with a deep clean and conditioning before buyers see it. We do mobile pre-sale details and tube polishing and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
